g.text: Synthetic 24 × 24-pixel CT patches with build texture, beam hardening, part edges, ring and streak artefacts and noise; defects are pores and lack-of-fusion flaws.
Network: two hidden layers (128, 32), scikit-learn, trained on 20 000 patches (30 % defective); tests on 24 000 patches at 3 % prevalence; the combined score is a
logistic regression on both outputs. Costs: review $1 500 per flagged part, escape $250 000 per missed defect; dots = minimum-cost threshold chosen on a separate
